note: the owner's manual test as a template. copy it OUTSIDE the repository, replace every <...> with a real link or number and run smoke-test.ps1 -LinksFile <copy>. the script does not start while a <...> is left. tracks is an exact count of different tracks, min_tracks a minimum, entries an exact count of places in the list with repeats (use it for lists that may have the same track twice), more_entries_than a lower bound for them. download_one marks the one collection whose first track is downloaded.
